english: …Hm, you're out already?
You're meeting your mom after so long;\nyou should talk longer.
//Aria arrives.
I would if I could.\nVisiting hours are super short.
So? Did she look well?
Her color wasn't bad.\nIf anything, she was worried about MY health.
Even though she's the one having it rough-\nwhat a good mom. Treasure her.
Obviously!!
Obviously, huh.
What? Did I say something weird?
(The Shinonono house is still broken apart\nbecause my sister created IS.\nI can't say anything about family…)
No, I think cherishing what you want\nto cherish is a good thing.
You're saying something that\ndoesn't sound like you?
There'll be no problem! None at all!
Sorry for making you worry about me.\nBut I'm fine.
For Mama's sake too, I'll catch Riko fast\nand drag her into court!
By the way, does Aria's mom\nlook like you?
Louise, that's what you're curious about?
What's wrong with that! Geez!
(Aria's kinda like me in some ways.\nIf so, maybe she takes after her mother…\nAm I overthinking this?)
What about Shirayuki and the others?
They should've gone to Butei High ahead of us.
//Scene change\n//Background: classroom inside Butei High\n//Shirayuki returns to the room where Remu and Mion are.
I've finished reporting to the Academic Affairs Office.
Anything unusual at Butei High?
No. After I left, there don't seem\nto have been any major incidents.
Jeanne, who was after me, hasn't\nshown herself since either.
Does that mean the enemy's got\nour movements figured out?
Probably.\nYou really did need\na bodyguard, Shirayuki-chan.
I'm sorry… I could've gone\ninto town with everyone…
It's fine!\nNobody went out to play anyway.
It was just accompanying Aria-chan and buying\ndaily necessities. We're the ones who got\nthe day off.
//The rest of the shopping squad returns.
I'm hooomee! I got to do lots of shopping,\nit was funn♪
I got to buy this world's idol magazines.\nUfufu, I can't wait to read them♪
I bought magic props from this world♪\nMufufu, my magic repertoire's\ngonna grow!!
Everyone, you're buying too many personal items.\nThough we did receive plenty of money\nfrom Aria-san and Shirayuki-san…
Especially you, Cecilia-san!\nTrying to buy three nightgowns\nis unacceptable!
I think it's normal to choose\ndifferent fabrics and designs\nfor temperature changes…
One pajama is enough.
Siesta-san is\nmercilessly strict…
Even though she was the shopping squad's bodyguard,\nCecilia-san tried\nto buy the most.
Well, if you had fun shopping, that's fine.
Oh, come to think of it, Aria-chan and\nthe others… they should be back soon…
Strange. I heard\nit wouldn't take long.
…I have a bad feeling about this.
//Scene change\n//Background: daytime town\n//Jeanne appears before Aria and the others
Y-you're…!!
Even though your face is already known, for you-\nsaid to be one of I-U's top strategists-\nto show up in broad daylight…
The 107 years of crimes pinned on Mama\nare yours, Durandal. Did you come all this\nway to get caught?
Don't call me that. Holmes the Fourth.
Then what's your business,\nthe 30th Jeanne d'Arc?
I've come to see the Bearer of Void- Louise the Zero.
Me?
I've been watching you ever since you\nleft Halkeginia. You've been in good\nform lately.
Oh, you've been watching closely. Thanks to that I'm on the upswing.\nNo idea why, though.
I've already investigated just how great\nyour true power is.
Louise Francoise Le Blanc de La Valliere-\nwhy not wield that magic\nfor us?
I refuse.
That was fast!\nShe even used your full name!
Of course! Who are you anyway?\nI feel like I've seen you somewhere,\nbut you're totally unmemorable!
You've been watching me from the shadows\nthis whole time? That's called stalking!\nI know these things!
Sorry, but I don't swing that way!\nIf you're looking for a lover, look elsewhere!
She's really letting loose…
Okay, you got rejected, so go home,\ngo home!
…I thought I knew your personality,\nbut it may exceed\nwhat I can imitate.
Imitate?
Disguising myself as you was hard work.\nThe personality, sure, but first and foremost,\nmaking my chest look small was the hard part.
Wh…!?
If I weren't a Matsugi,\nrecreating that sheer cliff\nwould've been impossible.
Wh, wha-wha…
What are you sayiiing!!!
Why are YOU snapping!?
I dunno what world you're from, but don't you\nknow there are things you just don't say,\nin every country…?
You too!?
I shouldn't have brought up something so silly.\nMore importantly…
Silly? Did you just say "silly"?\nDid I mishear, Aria?
No, she definitely said "silly."
Yeah… she brazenly said it\nwith the composure\nof a winner…
I don't need an apology.\nIt'd just piss me off anyway.
Which do you prefer: the Wind Hole Active\nVolcano (Volcaino), or Wind Hole Roulette?
Either's fine, let's just kill her already…!
You two, calm down a little!
Nooo, I'm gonna crush herrr!!!
…This isn't the flow I predicted,\nbut I anticipated it coming to force.
I'll freeze you along with that anger.
//Battle map: town (daytime)
Louise the Zero, I'm taking you.
Shut up and die!
Just die already!
Rip off!
(What vibe am I even supposed\nto fight with…?)
//Battle start
We're here to help!
Jeanne…!
We meet again. Shirayuki Hoshiga.\nHave you had a change of heart since?
Who would accept a forceful,\nobsessive invitation that ignores\nthe other person's feelings?
As expected of the student council president.\nShe's got it together.
(For some reason, coming from Shirayuki,\nit has zero persuasive power…)
Though people like that are often\nsurprisingly pushy in love themselves?
I mean, do you really have time\nto hit on girls? I think we're pretty\nwell winning here.
Hmph, I anticipated you\nshowing up.
Exactly!
//[NOEL] appears
My entrance timing was perfect! How about that?
[NOEL]!?
Oh my☆\nIf it isn't [NOEL]-chan.\nLong time no seee♪
[NOEL]! She's our teacher!
I told you before.\nThat's over and done with!
The time has come to prove I'm better!\nThat's all!
Teacher, she's saying such things!!
Hmm, why not?\nGive it a try?
Huh!?
Fighting in front of your master means\nyou're serious, right? Stopping you would\nmake me a failed teacher.
We should clash?\nOkay, I'll do it!!
Now!
//[MERU] appears
[MERU]!? What are you here for!?
Oh my☆\nIf it isn't [MERU]-chan.\nLong time no seee♪
[MERU]!\nI found our teacher!\nStop doing this stuff…
I've already decided I'll do it!\nWe'll settle who's better!
[MERU]-chan being so assertive!\nTeacher's happy☆ But it's making me tear up!\nI'm an educator!
Huh…? Teacher?
If you dodge this fight, you're disqualified\nas Magical Magicians☆
Uuuh, if you say that,\nall I can say is\n"I'll do it! Let me do it!"
I'll do it! I'll show you!
Looks like they're really going at it!\nI don't hate that kind of thing.
As long as there's no bad blood after, anyway.
//Battle resumes\n//Defeating Jeanne triggers retreat event
Louise's magic is growing even stronger,\nand Shirayuki's talent is blooming.\nLearning just that makes this worthwhile.
But this flow of fighting head-on…\ndoesn't suit me…
//Jeanne vanishes.
Tch, same trick as Riko… If we chase carelessly,\nshe'll just be waiting with traps, right?\nTrying to rile us up and lure us in.
Surprisingly calm.\nWere you guys just pretending to be angry?
Huh!?
You're not!?
//Event on defeating the Rival
This skirmish is enough for now.\nDon't think one fight\nsettles it!
What does [NOEL]\nwant, anyway?
You'll understand after we fight a few times. Bye!
//[NOEL] leaves the front.
Geez, I don't get it at all…
Worrying is part of growing too. Teacher's full of worries too,\nI'm at my wi- mmph☆
I wonder what she's worrying about…
I was off today!\nNext time!
You don't plan to end it here?
Of course! I'll make you admit\nI'm better!
//[MERU] leaves.
Geez, [MERU]'s\nonly tough with me!
Doesn't that mean she respects you that much?
You think so?
Besides, some relationships work better\nfacing off than side by side☆
I kinda get it.\nAlways being together isn't always best.\n…Right.
//Battle ends when all enemies are gone.\nBackground: daytime town
To think they'd come after Louise-san-\nsurprising.
Not really.\nSomeone took Tiffa, so it's no surprise\nI'm a target.
We still know nothing of\nTiffa-san's whereabouts.
But it's good news.\nIf they came after me, they must be connected\nto whoever took Tiffa.
She's probably safe, then.
Still, their speed bothers me.
We got here and they came at us\nright away.
Jeanne's a resident of this world,\nso it wouldn't be odd for her to have\nsome information network.
No, it is odd.
Huh?
Durandal favors schemes. She's not the type\nto show herself so casually. Yet she appeared\nin broad daylight and tried a forceful abduction.
Uncharacteristic, yes.
It doesn't sit right.\nMaybe she's taking orders from somewhere\nother than I-U…
Um! If it's okay, could we go back\nto Butei High for now…?
What is it?
I-if we stay like this, the people around\nwill be startled and it'll cause trouble…
Fufu, Nico-Nico-chan is the coolest one here.\nEveryone, let's head back!
True, let's pull out before this\ngets troublesome.
(That's right, tonight I get to sleep in\nmy own room for the first time in a while…)
I'm hooome-.
//Aria collapses onto the bed.\n//[Event art] Sleeping Aria
(This room's air, it's been a while…\nI've been in all that noise\nfor so long…)
(So quiet…)
(Just like Mama… alone in a quiet room.\nSorry, Mama… I still haven't\nfound a partner…)
Mama… I'll do my best…
//SE: Ding-dong! Doorbell.
Ariaaa! Comin' iiin!
Huh!?
//Event art off\n//Background: room\n//Suzu, Louise, and Remu come to Aria's room.
Hmm. There's nothing here.
You said "Butei,"\nso I pictured something\nlike a detective agency.
Hey, you guys!\nWhat are you doing barging into someone's room!\nThat's trespassing!
We're staying here tonight.\nOh, Suzu, make tea.
What's with that attitude!?
Just now, we all decided to go see\nAria-chan's room.\nSuzu-chan, tea for me too.
Huh?
And it's already late, so why not stay over?\nHere's your tea. …Oh, and Aria,\nI'm borrowing the kitchen.
Stop making yourselves at home!!\n…Tea for me too!
You're a coffee person, right?\nHere's a Stova premium.
Th-thanks…
Chinese food's fine, right?
//Suzu moves to the kitchen.
Hey, Suzu! Don't just use it!
Oh, what's this little plushie?\nA lion?
Aria, do you have any cute clothes?\nI think I could wear yours.
Hey! What is with all of you!?
Come on, don't be so stiff.
Yeah. …We're friends, right?
Wh-who said we're frie… huh…
Ariaaa! Come here a sec!
//Event art: Suzu cooking
Here, here, try a taste?
Hey!? How much sweet-and-sour pork\nare you making!?
There's ramen too, so don't worry!
That's not the point!!
Dessert's peach buns, though?
What?
Fufun, Suzu-san leaves nothing to chance!
//Event art off
F-fine… I'll let you stay\njust for tonight…
Fufu. Let's have fun chatting tonight!
Lend me your roomwear later, okay.
Come on, eat the sweet-and-sour pork!
I have no idea why girls our age\nare gathered around sweet-and-sour pork\nhaving a banquet…
What's wrong with it? Fun's better at times like this!
Times like this?
(Ah… could it be because\nshe just saw her mama…?)
Just so you know, I came to sleep\nin a better bed than the classroom.\nLend me your bed!
I came because I wanted to use the kitchen. Going all the way\nto Butei High's home-ec room is a pain.
I was curious about a Butei's room.\nIt's surprisingly normal, though.
I get it already!
(I get it, okay…)
I'm not letting you sleep till you finish\nthe sweet-and-sour pork and ramen!\nCome on, eat your bell peppers too!
There's no way I can eat all this!
The ramen after this is quite the formidable foe…
You guys deal with\nthe sweet-and-sour pork and ramen!\nI'm eating peach buns!
Peach buns are for after-dinner dessert!
Peach buns are a staple food!\nThey don't count as snacks!!
//Event art: Louise sleeping in a negligee
I'm going to sleep now.
Hey, don't sleep in the bed!\nThat's my spot!\nWind Hooole!!
//SE: gunshot
Whoa!? A ricochet- ahh!\nA bullet in the sweet-and-sour pork!\nWhat are you doing to the food-!!
Shut up! Take this!!
You asked for it! Dragon Roar!!
Hey! I can't sleep like this!!\nExplosion!!
//SE: smallish explosion sound
(Is this… prep for a midnight escape…)
